_comment: Outlaw Server daemon config. mode: 'panel' = browser control panel; 'lean' = no UI and no listener at all (SSH + the `outlaw` CLI only). Switch any time, then: systemctl restart outlaw-serverd
_host: Where the panel listens. Only two kinds of address are accepted: loopback (127.0.0.1), or an address belonging to a Tailscale/WireGuard interface, where traffic is already encrypted end to end. A LAN or public address is REFUSED and the daemon will not start. Use `outlaw remote bind` rather than editing this by hand.
_trustProxy: Trust X-Forwarded-For from a loopback peer. Set only by `outlaw remote serve on`, when Tailscale's HTTPS proxy is in front. Ignored unless the bind is loopback.
